_comment: DISCOVERY PIN 2. Every shipped FNS_Updater hardcodes three URLs and
nothing else; this is the second of them. It is a REWRITE (a 200
proxy), deliberately NOT a static copy committed here: a hand-kept
copy someone forgot to redeploy would serve a wrong endpoint forever
and look perfectly healthy, which is the exact failure the pin list
exists to survive. Proxying means this pin can only ever be stale in
the same way pin 1 is -- i.e. not at all.
Do NOT rename this path, remove this rule, or point it anywhere else.
Copies of the updater already in the field cannot be told about a
change here; editing the pin list mints a new generation of the
component, it does not fix installs that already shipped.
This rule only serves the pin if functionstore.tools is attached to
THIS Vercel project. Until 2026-08-28 the pin named the apex
functionstore.xyz, which belongs to a different project and 308s to
www, so the rewrite never fired and the pin 404'd like a merely
unpublished file. check_pins.py is what proves the difference.
